The author of the project is not a controller of your personal data: he never receives it. Account data is processed by the MAX service under its own rules, regardless of the modification.

en.h: 3. What is stored on the device

ul: Modification and module settings: switches, themes, wallpapers, spoofing parameters.
Messages and attachments kept by the Ayu module — in the app's local storage only.
App logs (up to 150 lines) for diagnostics; they can be cleared at any time.
Image cache and service files created by the messenger itself.

en.p: This data never leaves the device unless you send it yourself.

en.h: 4. Data processed by the MAX service

en.p: Phone number, messages, contacts, call metadata and other account information are processed by the MAX service exactly as in the original app. The modification does not change that scheme and has no access to the servers.

ul: Files and media — choosing wallpapers, sending attachments, saving screenshots.
Camera and microphone — calls, shooting and voice messages, as in the original.
Network — messenger operation and update downloads you initiate.
Notifications — messages and calls.

en.p: Permissions are requested when a feature is actually used.
The modification blocks requests to analytics, tracker and statistics domains, reducing telemetry. The current block list is published separately and updated as needed.
The project makes no calls home: the modification sends no statistics, identifiers or crash reports to the Author's servers.
Logs, screenshots and issue descriptions are sent voluntarily — to the chat or direct messages. Before sending, remove anything you do not want to show: phone numbers, names, message texts.
Such reports are kept in the conversation for as long as needed to investigate and are deleted at your request.
The modification is not intended for children and does not collect data about them. Children's use of the service is governed by the service's own rules.
